value.rationale: A two-layer 3×3 rectangular lattice is a canonical minimal 3D thickening of the planar width-three grids that motivate the problem. Its 90,039-face matching complex has a nontrivial, precisely classified 48-sphere homotopy type; the unit-minor certificate determines integral attaching maps rather than only Betti numbers. It provides a useful exact benchmark for three-dimensional grid-matching topology, with no invented arbitrary parameter slice or unsupported generalization.
